name: Primary Button
css: .btn-primary { display: inline-flex; align-items: center; justify-content: center; padding: 0.625rem 1.25rem; background-color: #0683FF; color: #F0F4FF; font-family: 'Plus Jakarta Sans', sans-serif; font-size: 0.875rem; font-weight: 600; border: none; border-radius: 8px; cursor: pointer; transition: background-color 0.2s ease; } .btn-primary:hover { background-color: #0570d8; }

name: Outline Button
css: .btn-outline { display: inline-flex; align-items: center; justify-content: center; padding: 0.625rem 1.25rem; background-color: transparent; color: #F0F4FF; font-family: 'Plus Jakarta Sans', sans-serif; font-size: 0.875rem; font-weight: 600; border: 1.5px solid #2A3650; border-radius: 8px; cursor: pointer; transition: border-color 0.2s ease, color 0.2s ease; } .btn-outline:hover { border-color: #0683FF; color: #0683FF; }

name: Badge
css: .badge { display: inline-flex; align-items: center; padding: 0.25rem 0.625rem; background-color: rgba(6, 131, 255, 0.12); color: #0683FF; font-family: 'Plus Jakarta Sans', sans-serif; font-size: 0.75rem; font-weight: 600; border-radius: 999px; letter-spacing: 0.02em; }
